prompt:
Create one clean pixel-art reference atlas for the existing NPC080 afraid/thinking eyes. Use the single attached 2x2 image as the exact portrait identity, emotion, palette, spacing, and blink-phase reference. Preserve this NPC's visible face, curly brown hair/head silhouette, muted warm tan skin, olive-green eyes, worried/fearful brow shapes, and anxious expression. Keep the same pixel scale and low-resolution sprite rendering.

Canvas: one seamless two-column by two-row sheet, without margin, gutters, labels, extra faces, text, or decoration. Preserve the reference canvas ratio 1024:560 and the cell ratio 64:35. Cell order must be: top-left open eyes looking LEFT; top-right open eyes looking RIGHT; bottom-left half-blink eyes looking LEFT; bottom-right half-blink eyes looking RIGHT. Keep the eyes and surrounding features in the same locations in every cell. The two directions must be clear horizontal iris/pupil shifts within the existing openings; do not move the gaze vertically.

Keep both olive irises compact, natural and irregular/stepped, with pupils contained inside the visible eye opening in every pose. Keep the upper and lower eyelid contours continuous in all open and half-blink cells. Half-blink cells retain the same gaze direction as the open cell above them. Highlights should be tiny, subdued warm accents consistent with the reference, not bright white flashes. Avoid square or bar-shaped irises, oversized white sclera, iris or pupil crossing any lid, disconnected lids, brow changes, expression changes, perspective or face redesign, smoothing, antialiasing, blur, and any added content.
